entries.candidate: SoftBank (former IDC Frontier) Nara Ikoma Data Center, former NEC Kansai Research Laboratories site, Takayama-cho, Ikoma, Nara (Building A operating; Building B planned)
entries.status_candidate: operational (Building A opened October 2025; no in-window dated statement)
entries.reason: New lead, not in the Atlas (no Nara record exists). The operator's facility page (idcf.jp/datacenter/location/ikoma/, captured 2026-10-23 as local idcf-ikoma.html, sha256 6a8975a710e49d8d..., 138,740 bytes) describes the Nara Ikoma Data Center in the present tense as a large data centre in the Keihanna area with 50 MW of total receiving capacity and about 40,000 m2 of floor area after the second building (both marked as planned figures), air and direct liquid cooling and on-site operations, and says IDC Frontier's data-centre business passed to SoftBank Corp. on 1 April 2026. The page carries no publication or modification date, and the idcf.jp sitemap (captured by the 17 October lane) gives no lastmod for it, so it cannot set an in-window observation day. IDC Frontier's press and news lists stop in February 2026; SoftBank's July to October 2026 press releases (44 titles captured by the 17 October lane), SoftBank News data-centre category, the SoftBank datacenter news page, the FY2026 Q1 results Q&A pages and Q1 financial report (sb-ir-fy2026-q1_earnings_qa.html, sb-ir-fy2026-q1_investors_qa.html, sbkk-financial-report-20260804.pdf) and BBIX's news list (Osaka No. 9 inside the facility opened December 2025) contain no dated in-window Ikoma statement. A directory listing (Baxtel, discovery only, baxtel-softbank-nara-ikoma.html) gives the site as 8916-47 Takayama-cho and Building A as 17,835 m2; that address is not from a primary source here, and no lot or address point was prepared.
entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window SoftBank, BBIX or Ikoma City statement that the Nara Ikoma Data Center (or its Building A) operates, or a Building B announcement or construction record, together with a primary address, an MOJ lot for the Takayama-cho site or a named map feature. Screen it against KAGOYA Keihanna Lab and the MC Digital Realty KIX14 plan in Ikoma.

entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window MCDR, Digital Realty or Ikoma City record naming KIX14 (announcement, building permit, construction start), with its lot or a site map; it would be a new site in Ikoma, screened against SoftBank Nara Ikoma.

entries.reopen_condition: A dated in-window Equinix filing, release or Osaka City record (building notice, CASBEE filing) naming OS6, read through a robots-permitted route or an archived copy, plus its lot or address point.

entries.candidate: Highreso 男鹿市データセンター (Oga City Data Center), former Haratodo Elementary School, 男鹿市払戸字渡部97, Akita
entries.reason: New lead not reached by earlier passes. CIAJ's grant-decision list for the FY2024-supplementary MIC data-centre programme (ciaj-kouhukettei-R6-3-dc.pdf, published April 2026) names 株式会社ハイレゾ at 秋田県男鹿市. Akita Prefecture's attracted-company summary dated 12 March 2026 (akita-yuuchi-highreso.pdf) gives the site exactly: 男鹿市払戸字渡部97 (former Haratodo Elementary School), site 15,232 m2, building 1,211 m2, GPU data-centre operation, operation start planned for August 2027 (令和9年8月). Oga's mayor told the council on 24 February 2026 that a location agreement would be signed on 12 March, and the June 2026 session approved the city's own contract to demolish the former school (議案第52号). No dated primary record from 30 July 2026 onward names the project: the mayor's reports of 31 July and 2 September 2026, the July and September 2026 resolution lists, Oga's newsletters for April to October 2026, Akita Prefecture's location pages to 15 October 2026 and Highreso's news items from 28 July to 23 October 2026 (whose company history lists only Shika, Takamatsu, Genkai and Ayagawa as opened) contain no Oga item. The planned operation date is a forecast, and the city's demolition contract is not tied to data-centre works in the records found, so neither establishes a physical stage.
entries.reopen_condition: Any dated Highreso, Oga City or Akita Prefecture record within the admission window naming the Oga data centre (for example a construction start, building permit, site handover or opening). The lot 払戸字渡部97 is a ready locator (MOJ/AIGID registry-map parcel data for Oga City, code 05206).

The rule not to assume the Sendai power-station site stands.
